scenarios.prompt: User says 'make the notification component more robust' and asks for a spec.
expected: asks clarifying questions instead of writing requirements from the vague phrase
every produced requirement has an EARS statement and a Given/When/Then acceptance that can fail a test
unanswerable business questions become blocking open questions, not guesses

scenarios.prompt: A 'new feature' changes the error code returned by an existing API path; the agent labels it Change Type = new.
expected: requires the existing behavior baseline and regression acceptance
splits the row if new and modify signals are mixed

scenarios.prompt: The input says the operation should be 'fast enough' and the agent wants to write NFR-001: performance should be good.
expected: refuses an NFR without a QAS Response Measure threshold
asks the requirement owner for the threshold or files a blocking open question

scenarios.prompt: The agent produces a good spec.md and asks R1 to pass, but did not create traceability.md rows or the plan.md run-mode/gate skeleton.
expected: treats the missing traceability.md and plan.md skeleton as an R1 gate gap
initializes one traceability row per core FR/NFR/IFR/measurable CON with Change Type and source anchors
creates plan.md with run mode, gate table, and plan boundary before spec review can pass
